summary: The old harness has four preexisting parsing-mode coverage gaps. Neither selected change introduces a demonstrated harness gap.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete header defines the document configuration and parsing contracts.
The build recipe identifies the library and harness compilation path.
The Makefile supplies the library build target used by the recipe.

claims.necessity_reason: A nested XML input reaches document cleanup, and both implementations recursively delete parsed descendants.

before.requirement: Destroy a parsed document with nested nodes while safely deleting its descendants.
before.reason: Document destruction calls Clear; the old node destructor deletes children through DeleteChildren and DeleteChild.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Document destruction invokes Clear.
Clear deletes document children.
DeleteChildren processes each child.
DeleteChild unlinks and deletes the child.

after.requirement: Destroy a parsed document with nested nodes while safely deleting its descendants.
after.reason: The changed destructor saves the next sibling, clears the child's parent, and deletes the child; document destruction still invokes Clear.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Document destruction invokes Clear.
Clear deletes document children.
Static DeleteNode destroys each child and frees its allocation.
The changed destructor clears the parent before MarkInUse checks it.

claims.comparison_reason: The same local document reaches cleanup on both sides, and neither deletion path requires another harness operation.

claims.necessity_reason: The changed null-argument behavior concerns a direct DeleteNode call that the complete fuzz entry does not make or expose through its input.

before.requirement: A direct XMLDocument::DeleteNode(nullptr) call returns before dereferencing or asserting about the node.
before.reason: The old implementation asserts before its null guard, but the target does not make the direct null call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: ParseDeep checks for an absent identified node before its deletion call.
Clear deletes an indexed unlinked entry only while the list is nonempty.

after.requirement: A direct XMLDocument::DeleteNode(nullptr) call returns before dereferencing or asserting about the node.
after.reason: The new implementation returns before asserting, but the target still has no direct null call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: ParseDeep checks for an absent identified node before its deletion call.
The changed destructor deletes only nonnull children through XMLNode::DeleteNode.

claims.comparison_reason: The direct null-call tuple is outside the fixed entry's operational surface on both versions.

claims.necessity_reason: The document supports an entity-preserving ordinary-text mode, but the harness always selects the entity-processing default. XML input cannot change that setting.

before.requirement: Parse ordinary text such as & with processEntities=false so its text value retains the entity.
before.reason: The harness constructs XMLDocument without arguments, selecting processEntities=true.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The leave-entities text mode omits entity processing.
The selected change concerns cleanup of parsed nodes.

after.requirement: Parse ordinary text such as & with processEntities=false so its text value retains the entity.
after.reason: The mode remains supported, and the same harness still selects the true default.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The leave-entities text mode still omits entity processing.
The selected change concerns cleanup of parsed nodes.

claims.comparison_reason: Both versions support the same mode; the same default-only document construction blocks it.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions support whitespace collapsing for ordinary text, while the harness fixes the document to PRESERVE_WHITESPACE.

before.requirement: Parse text such as x y with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected.
before.reason: The no-argument constructor selects PRESERVE_WHITESPACE, and XML bytes cannot change the mode.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Text parsing enables the collapsing flag only for COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.
The flag produces a distinct collapsed text value.

after.requirement: Parse text such as x y with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected.
after.reason: The mode remains supported; the same harness still selects PRESERVE_WHITESPACE.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Text parsing still enables the collapsing flag only for COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.
The flag still produces a distinct collapsed text value.

claims.comparison_reason: The supported mode and the harness's fixed constructor are unchanged.

claims.necessity_reason: PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE supports retaining literal whitespace-only text before a closing tag; the harness cannot select that mode.

before.requirement: Parse <r>  </r> with PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE and retain the spaces as a text child.
before.reason: The harness uses the PRESERVE_WHITESPACE constructor default, so Identify does not take its pedantic text path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The header declares PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE as a selectable mode.
The constructor defaults to PRESERVE_WHITESPACE.

after.requirement: Parse <r>  </r> with PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE and retain the spaces as a text child.
after.reason: The pedantic path remains supported, while the same harness still uses the preservation default.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The header declares PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE as a selectable mode.
The constructor defaults to PRESERVE_WHITESPACE.

claims.comparison_reason: The same default-only construction prevents selection of PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE on both sides.

claims.necessity_reason: The processEntities=false setting also selects a distinct attribute-value parsing mode. The old harness cannot select it, independently of ordinary-text parsing.

before.requirement: Parse an attribute such as x="&" with processEntities=false, retaining the entity in its value.
before.reason: The harness constructs a default document with processEntities=true; attribute parsing receives that setting.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The attribute leave-entities mode omits the entity-processing flag.
The constructor defaults processEntities to true.
Element parsing passes the document's entity setting to attribute parsing.

after.requirement: Parse an attribute such as x="&" with processEntities=false, retaining the entity in its value.
after.reason: The attribute mode remains supported, while the same harness still selects processEntities=true.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The attribute leave-entities mode still omits the entity-processing flag.
The constructor still defaults processEntities to true.
Element parsing still passes the document's entity setting to attribute parsing.

claims.comparison_reason: Attribute values use a separate parsing path from text values, but the same fixed true constructor default blocks this behavior before and after.
